reading.rtitle: Copenhagen, Day One: We Don't Always Agree
paras: Our first day in Copenhagen! Leão and I walked all day, and we talked about everything. We don't always agree, and that is the fun part.
First, Nyhavn: the old canal with red, yellow and blue houses. I said: “I think it's beautiful.” Leão said: “I agree. It's amazing.” We took a lot of photos.

Then we walked over a long bridge to see the Little Mermaid. She is a very famous statue, but she is very small. Leão said: “I don't think it's interesting. I think it's a little boring.” I didn't agree. I think she is beautiful.
At lunch I asked him: “What's your opinion of the food here?” He said: “I think it's expensive, but it's very good.” “Me too,” I said. “I think so too.”
At night we went to Tivoli, the old park in the center. Leão loved it. “I think this is my favorite place in the city,” he said. I don't agree: my favorite is the canal. But Tivoli is amazing too.

listenings.text: My husband and I were in Rome last month, and we don't always agree. I think Rome is beautiful, but he thinks it's too hot in the summer. OK, I agree with him about that! The food? We both think it's amazing. The museums? I think they are very interesting, but he doesn't think so. He thinks they are boring and very crowded. Our hotel was small, but I think it was cozy. He didn't agree. He thinks it was noisy. So, what's my opinion of the trip? I think it was great. And his opinion? He says: next time, Copenhagen!

Hello, everyone, and welcome to the canal tour. On your left is Nyhavn. These houses are three hundred years old. I think they are beautiful, and I hope you agree. Now we go under a small bridge, so please sit down! In front of us is the Opera House. Some people think it is ugly. I don't think so. I think it's amazing, especially at night. And now, on the right, the Little Mermaid. Many visitors say she is small and a little boring. What do you think? In my opinion, she is small, but she is the symbol of the city. The tour ends in twenty minutes. Enjoy the view!
